description: Default capabilities for Claude3PCost — read-only fs access, no scope entries (S7 plan §2.1, §2.3, §5.6): nothing is readable until src-tauri/src/lib.rs grants a directory at runtime. S15 plan §5.2.4 adds dialog:allow-save (US-4.2 export) — the fs: permission list itself stays exactly the S7 read set: JSON export/import go through two Rust commands (write_export_file, read_import_file), never through @tauri-apps/plugin-fs.
